## Key data decisions so far

- **Source file unchanged.** It is read from outside the repository; all recodes are made in code and the original values are kept next to the recoded ones.
- **Item rules in one table** (`spec/item_spec.csv`): wording, waves, range, reversal and special codes. The scripts read the rules from this table.
- **Anomie items 4-5 are already reverse-scored in the extract.** Reversing them as the guide suggests produced negative inter-item correlations, so they are not reversed again (to confirm with PPBS).
- **Relative deprivation** is a single item, reversed so that higher means more deprived; validated against household income (ρ ≈ -.63).
- **Rehabilitation:** "not able to answer" is coded 97 in waves 4-5 but stored as blank in wave 3; both are treated as missing and reported.
- **Causal attribution:** two separate scores (societal, individual) instead of one, based on factor analysis; items 2 and 3 excluded.
- **Sample:** all 500 respondents took part in all five waves; results describe this panel, not the population.
- **Public site:** aggregate results only; groups with fewer than 10 respondents are suppressed; an automated check scans the built site for data files and respondent IDs before publishing.
